title: Be a registered surveyor
what: Carry out surveys only as a registered surveyor or under a surveyor's supervision.

sources.title: Surveyors Act 2007 (ACT)
sources.locator: s 49 (current republication (R13, from 22 May 2026; Surveyors Act 2007 | Acts))
sources.quote: A person commits an offence if the person–– (a) carries out a survey; and (b) is not a surveyor, or supervised by a surveyor, when the survey is carried out
